title: What Sky Pirate Job Are You Most Like?
intro: Every airship needs a crew. Answer nine questions and I'll tell you where you'd sign on.
share: Screenshot this and tag @mauriceafrich with your result.

descriptors.name: Bold
descriptors.def: Runs toward trouble. Big swings, loud calls, no flinching.

descriptors.name: Steady
descriptors.def: Calm hands and a level head. Keeps things running when it gets bumpy.

descriptors.name: Clever
descriptors.def: Thinks it through. Puzzles, plans, maps, and math.

descriptors.name: Crafty
descriptors.def: Makes something out of nothing. Fixes, builds, and improvises.

descriptors.name: Watchful
descriptors.def: Notices everything. Sees the storm, the liar, and the shiny thing first.

descriptors.name: Charming
descriptors.def: Talks people into things. Leads, haggles, and wins the room.

descriptors.name: Loyal
descriptors.def: Crew first, always. Stands in front of their people.

descriptors.name: Restless
descriptors.def: Can't sit still. Always moving, always curious, always halfway out the door.

jobs.title: Captain
jobs.description: You make the call when the sky turns ugly, and somehow the crew follows you into it. You are calm, a little reckless, and you never leave anyone behind on the dock.

jobs.title: Pilot
jobs.tagline: Hands on the wheel, eyes on the clouds.
jobs.description: You feel the wind before it hits. Tight gaps, sudden drops, and storms are just a good day at work. The crew holds on and trusts you to bring the ship home in one piece.

jobs.title: Gunner
jobs.tagline: Loud, loyal, and very hard to argue with.
jobs.description: When trouble shows up off the bow, you are already loading. You protect your people first and ask questions later, and nobody sleeps better than the crew with you on watch.

jobs.title: Runner
jobs.description: You carry the messages, the deals, and the gossip from one end of the ship to the other, and from port to port. If something needs doing yesterday, you are the one already halfway there.

jobs.title: Techtailor
jobs.tagline: Needle in one hand, wrench in the other.
jobs.description: You stitch sails, patch engines, and make gear nobody else could dream up from scraps. When something breaks, the crew yells your name, and you are already rolling up your sleeves.

jobs.title: Quartermaster
jobs.tagline: Every coin counted, every barrel stacked.
jobs.description: You keep the crew fed, paid, and honest. You know exactly what is in the hold, who owes what, and how to split the loot so nobody starts a mutiny over it.

jobs.title: Navigator
jobs.description: You read the sky like a book and always know which way home is. Where everyone else sees endless clouds, you see a route, a shortcut, and a secret island nobody has charted yet.

jobs.title: Lookout
jobs.description: Up in the crow's nest, you spot the storm, the rival ship, and the shiny thing on the horizon long before anyone else. You notice the small stuff, and that is exactly why the crew is still alive.

questions.text: A rival airship pulls up alongside. What do you do?

answers.text: Hail them and do the talking
Swing us hard into the clouds
Step in front of my crew and roll out the cannons
Count their crew and their cargo

questions.text: Pick your spot on the ship.

answers.text: The wheel, obviously
The crow's nest, way up top
The workshop below deck
The chart table by the lanterns

questions.text: Shore leave in a new port. Where are you headed?

answers.text: The market, to stock the hold before prices go up
Everywhere at once, I have errands
The map shop with the dusty back room
The docks, to make sure nobody messes with our ship

questions.text: What is in your pockets right now?

answers.text: A compass and a half-drawn map
Spare bolts, thread, and a tiny screwdriver
A spyglass and a snack for whoever is on watch with me
A sealed letter I am not supposed to read

questions.text: The crew is arguing over the loot. You...

answers.text: Split it fair and write it down
Settle it with one look
Hide the best piece until they calm down
Fire one warning shot into the sky

questions.text: Something just broke and the ship is shaking. Your move?

answers.text: Hold her steady with both hands
Find the safest route down
Patch it with whatever is lying around
Get every hand to a rope and keep them calm
Hardtack, rationed carefully
Whatever I can eat while running
Spicy jerky, shared with my gun crew
Cloudberry pie, and I know exactly who took the last slice

questions.text: A storm is coming. What is your first thought?

answers.text: I saw it an hour ago
I know a way around it
Let's fly right through it
Are the sails stitched tight?

questions.text: Your crew would describe you as...

answers.text: The one in charge
The one who would take a cannonball for them
The one who never runs out of anything
The one you can never catch
